title: Give rejected recovery notices an actionable disposition after their Engram grant closes
outcome: A RecoveryNotice-origin head rejected under an Engram grant does not remain silently interrupted with only spent authorization after the exact checkpoint succeeds. Its disposition is explicit and recoverable under existing ownership, cancellation and no-recursive-notice rules, without authorizing unsafe replay or blocking unrelated queue entries indefinitely.
acceptance: Give rejected recovery notices an actionable disposition after their Engram grant closes is done
